## Find your own percentile {.smaller}

::: {.small}
- Open the **'your percentile'** cell in the browser lab. Everyone uses it for this step, and it runs in any browser tab with no installation
- Enter the result you submitted before the break – it computes the share of the 840 specifications more negative than yours, on the claim-aligned scale
- The same statistic that placed the five analysts, computed for **you**
:::

::: {.fragment}
Paste your percentile in chat – hold – send on "go".
:::

::: notes
Your turn to be placed. Open the percentile chunk in the browser lab – those of you working in the workspace too, since this one is only in the lab and runs in a browser tab – and give it your submitted result. It computes for you the same statistic that I computed for the five analysts: the share of the whole grid that is more negative than your value. Two or three minutes. Then paste your percentile in chat, hold it, send on go. [go] Look at the range in the chat – the class spans a good stretch of the curve, and every one of you can now say where you stand relative to eight hundred and forty defensible alternatives. That sentence – "my estimate sits at the Nth percentile of the specification space" – is a publishable way to report a robustness check, and you have just done it.
:::
